Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for Escherichia coli (>100,000 CFU/mL). Hematuria is present. Low urine specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
